arabic text: YEH RAAZ KYA HAI DUNIYA KAI BANANAY WAALAY\nBAI SAHARA HAI TERA DHEEN BACHANAY WAALAY
english translation text: What mystery is this, O Creator of the world?\nThe one who saved Your religion is left without support.

arabic text: TAH VOH DARBAAR MAGAR LOGH WOHI THAY NANA\nTUJ PAI HIZIYAAN KA JO ILZAAM LAGAANAY WAALAY
english translation text: That was a court, yet the people were the same, Grandfather—\nthe very ones who had accused you of delirium.

arabic text: KUFA AUR SHAAM KA DASTOOR NIRAALA DEKHA\nQATL KARTAY HAIN WOH MEHMAAN BULAANAY\nWAALAY
english translation text: I saw the strange custom of\nKufa and Shaam: they invite a\nguest, and then they kill him.

arabic text: KYUN LARAZTI HAI ZAMEEN AUR UDAASI KYUN HAI\nKOUN HAY SHAAM KAY BAZAAR MAIN AANAY WAALAY
english translation text: Why does the earth tremble, and why is there such sorrow?\nWho is entering the marketplace of Shaam?

arabic text: DARKAY ZALIM KAY TAMACHON SAY SAKINA NAY\nKAHA\nABH TO AAJAO HUMAY PAANI PILAANAY WAALAY
english translation text: Terrified by the tyrant’s slaps,\nSakina cried: ‘Come now, you who\nused to bring us water.’
